INSERT INTO KEPRQDT (BUYER, QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ, REVISION, STATUS, RECV_FLAG, BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, MAKER_CODE, MAKER_NAME, ORIGIN_CODE, ORIGIN_NAME, BTOA_DATE, BTOA_TIME, BTOA_END_DATE, BTOA_END_TIME, BTOA_USER_ID, BTOA_USER_NAME, BTOA_USER_DEPT, BTOA_USER_TEL, BTOA_USER_FAX, BTOA_USER_MAIL, SO_CA_FLAG, KEP_RECV_USER_ID, AGENT_NAME) (SELECT A.BUYER AS BUYER, #{QUOTATION_NO} AS QUOTATION_NO, -- 1 : QUOTATION_NO LPAD(#{QUOTATION_SEQ}, 6, '0') AS QUOTATION_SEQ, -- 2 : QUOTATION_SEQ 1 AS REVISION, 'C' AS STATUS, 'NW' AS RECV_FLAG, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, A.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, A.MAKER_CODE AS MAKER_CODE, A.MAKER_NAME AS MAKER_NAME, A.ORIGIN_CODE AS ORIGIN_CODE, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M001' AND CODE=A.ORIGIN_CODE) AS ORIGIN_NAME, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS BTOA_DATE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') AS BTOA_TIME, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS BTOA_DATE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') AS BTOA_TIME, #{st_user_id} AS BTOA_USER_ID, -- 2 : st_user_id (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{st_user_id}) AS BTOA_USER_NAME, -- 3 : st_user_id (SELECT DEPARTMENT FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{st_user_id}) AS BTOA_USER_DEPT, -- 4 : st_user_id (SELECT PHONE_NUMBER FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{st_user_id}) AS BTOA_USER_TEL, -- 5 : st_user_id (SELECT FAX_NUMBER FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{st_user_id}) AS BTOA_USER_FAX, -- 6 : st_user_id (SELECT EMAIL FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{st_user_id}) AS BTOA_USER_MAIL, -- 7 : st_user_id 'CA' AS SO_CA_FLAG, #{st_user_id} AS KEP_RECV_USER_ID, -- 8 : st_user_id AGENT_NAME FROM ICOMBYIT_ADD A WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} -- 9 : st_buyer_code AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO=#{BUYER_ITEM_NO} -- 10 : BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.SEQ=#{SEQ} -- 11 : SEQ AND A.STATUS = 'C' )
mapper.select: /*getBuyerRateAdaptFlag*/ SELECT NVL(PRIMECOST_ADAPT,'N') AS ADAPT_FLAG FROM TBL_BUYER_PRIMECOST_MNG WHERE BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} AND STATUS='C'

/*getProcessTypeRateInfo*/ SELECT DECODE(#{st_process_type},0, NVL(SUPPLY_DIRECT_RATE,0), 1, NVL(STOCK_RATE,0),2,NVL(TR_RATE,0),3,NVL(VMI_RATE,0))+DECODE(#{st_import_flag},'Y', NVL(IMPORT_RATE,0), 'N', 0,0) AS RLT_RATE FROM TBL_PROCESSTYPE_PRIMECOST_MNG WHERE STATUS='C'

SELECT NVL (SUPPLY_DIRECT_RATE, 0) AS SUPPLY_DIRECT_RATE, NVL (STOCK_RATE, 0) AS STOCK_RATE, NVL (TR_RATE, 0) AS TR_RATE, NVL (VMI_RATE, 0) AS VMI_RATE, NVL (IMPORT_RATE, 0) AS IMPORT_RATE FROM TBL_PROCESSTYPE_PRIMECOST_MNG WHERE STATUS = 'C'
mapper.update: UPDATE ICOMBYIT_ADD X SET STATUS = 'R', MARGIN_RE = (SELECT B.MARGIN_RE FROM KEPMGPHD A, KEPMGPDT B, ICOMCMPY C WHERE A.BUYER = #{KEY_2} --[01] BUYER AND A.PM_NO = #{KEY_1} --[02] PM_NO AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.PM_NO = B.PM_NO AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND A.BUYER = C.COM_CODE AND X.BUYER = C.BYCA_COMORG_CODE AND X.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND X.SEQ = B.PO_NO) WHERE BUYER = (SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = #{KEY_2}) --[03] BUYER AND BUYER_ITEM_NO IN (SELECT B.BUYER_ITEM_NO FROM KEPMGPHD A, KEPMGPDT B WHERE A.BUYER = #{KEY_2} --[04] BUYER AND A.PM_NO = #{KEY_1} --[05] PM_NO AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.PM_NO = B.PM_NO AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND A.STATUS <> 'D') AND (BUYER_ITEM_NO, AGENT_CODE, SEQ) IN (SELECT B.BUYER_ITEM_NO, B.AGENT, B.PO_NO FROM KEPMGPHD A, KEPMGPDT B WHERE A.BUYER = #{KEY_2} --[06] BUYER AND A.PM_NO = #{KEY_1} --[07] PM_NO AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.PM_NO = B.PM_NO AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND A.STATUS <> 'D') AND STATUS IN ('C', 'Q')
